visibility_rule: Only unlocked active skills appear; rows/frame grow or contract; no locked placeholders; stable key labels.

concepts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit, pixel-game HUD mockup. Produce one complete full-screen16:9 Battle of Gods gameplay preview. Input image1 is the EDIT TARGET and the chosen layout identity. Preserve its forest terrain, paths, trees, tiny black-haired red-scarf King/sword action, top-center ROOTBOUND HUSK enemy panel, top-left Bag/Menu controls and upper-right objective. Change only the BOTTOM PLAYER/ABILITY UI to demonstrate the exact unlocked-skill state described below. Input image2 is the supporting original style reference for this same layout. Retain original shaded pixel-RPG materials: crisp weathered silver/iron, near-black obsidian, ivory typography, tiny violet/cyan accents, red HP and thin blue-violet XP. No broad gold frame, giant wings or new screen overlays. UI must fit logical960x540 and remain reasonably compact: icon glyphs about28-32 logical pixels, key text at least10 logical pixels. Keep icon size CONSISTENT between early/mid/full samples; shrink the surrounding dock when fewer skills exist, never enlarge four icons into the width of ten. LOCKED AND NOT-YET-LEARNED SKILLS ARE COMPLETELY ABSENT: no padlocks, EMPTY cards, ghosts, vacant square slots, extra holes, unused reserved rectangles or blank skill rows. Only the expressly listed active skills have buttons. Cooling-down skills remain visible. Keep HP '1,240 / 1,600' (two lines for an orb), level12 exactly once, a slim XP strip '4,250 / 10,000 XP', a modest weapon badge with 'MASTERY 5', and one separate 'SPACE' dodge utility. No minimap. Treat portrait/weapon/dodge utilities as visually distinct from ability buttons so the exact skill count is unambiguous. No extra LMB attack button. All character/world artwork and top interface must retain the source composition. No arrows, annotation board, watermarks or big concept titles. Review-only illustrative values. Final image is one usable-looking gameplay screenshot.

LAYOUT A — RELIC ORBIT. Preserve a compact central ruby HEALTH ORB with current/max digits inside and a single level12 plate beneath. Keep the orb at the same bottom-center anchor in every state. Skill groups flank the orb symmetrically. Thin original iron/violet frame, small portrait at far left, separate SPACE utility far right. The dock and XP strip CONTRACT around the actual populated groups. If weapon techniques exist, they occupy the upper row and King powers the lower row; otherwise the weapon row and its header disappear entirely.

UNLOCK STATE — EARLY, EXACTLY FOUR ABILITY BUTTONS TOTAL. There are FOUR King powers labeled exactly1,2,3,4 and ZERO weapon techniques. Remove every F-key button and the entire empty weapon-skill row/header. A: place King1,2 LEFT of the orb, King3,4 RIGHT. B/C: one compact row of King1,2,3,4. Four distinct painted power glyphs, all available; no cooldown numeral needed. Maintain small ordinary icon sizes and significantly contract the frame/HP or XP dock to match this small group. Absolutely NO extra skills, no locked cards, no F labels. COUNT exactly4 numbered skill icons.
